messages:
Maria: Heads up — eviction rate for GPU pods in eu-west1 rack shelf-43 spiked ~3x after the last provisioning. We landed a mixed batch of 80GB + 40GB cards into the same rack and the ToR NICs are at ~90% tx. Pods either get preempted or remain Pending with "InsufficientGPU".
Ashok: ugh. can you paste the alert/dashboard link?
Maria: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west1/d/gpu-capacity-eu/slot-health (just the grafana panel link, filter eu-west1:shelf-43)
Maria: quick pod snapshot:
```
kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep gpu-model
pod-a    0/1   Pending   node=   reason=InsufficientGPU
pod-b    1/1   Running   node=eu-west1-shelf43-0   gpu=40GB
```
Ashok: looks like fractional packing + hetero flavors. Scheduler currently binpacks by free GPU count which causes tiny leftovers and then backfills pull traffic across NVLink islands — that plus the NIC TX spike leads to preempt cascades.
Jess: can we do a quick mitigation (label/taint) to stop mixing flavors while we plan a scheduler change?
Ashok: two quick options: 1) label new nodes with flavor and preferDuringScheduling, 2) taint them with `flavor=40gb:PreferNoSchedule` and add tolerations for batch. Avoid full NoSchedule unless we want forced evictions.
Jess: propose this small node-label script to isolate the batch:
```
kubectl label nodes eu-west1-shelf43-0 eu-west1-shelf43-1 gpu_flavor=40gb --overwrite
# later: kubectl taint nodes eu-west1-shelf43-0 gpu_flavor=40gb:PreferNoSchedule --overwrite
```
Kai: caution — PreferNoSchedule taint is a hint only. If autoscaler continues to mix, we'll still get hetero packing. Also watch the nvidia-device-plugin logs for device topology warnings.
Maria: FYI telemetry shows most evictions tagged `node.kubernetes.io/out-of-resources` + preemption events at 10:12 UTC. Network alerts from #monitoring were fired at the same time (ToR TX ~90%).
Ashok: short-term play: mark the new nodes as `provisioning=isolated` and route low-priority batch jobs there (set PriorityClass). Patch autoscaler to prefer same-flavor pools. Mid-term: add a scheduler predicate/score to prefer same-family packing and NVLink island awareness.
Jess: i'll open an RFC + a quick autoscaler config PR. RFC: https://git.redwood/rfcs/123 (placeholder)
deploy-bot: annotation applied: nodes eu-west1-shelf43-0..5 -> `provisioning=isolated` (by @Jess)
Kai: also consider reducing default spot worker pool pod `resources.requests.gpu` for the autoscaler so fractional leftovers are minimized.
Maria: thanks — i've started a rolling label for the batch (no taints yet). i'll keep monitoring for 2h and post an update. :thumbsup:
